description: This PHP class defines LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping, a data transfer object for mapping LDAP employee attributes, including methods for conversion, extraction, and creation from arrays.

classes.name: LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping
classes.description: A data transfer object for LDAP employee attribute mappings, with methods for array conversion, attribute extraction, and creation from array.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns all stored mappings as an array.

methods.name: getAllAttributeNames
methods.description: Retrieves all attribute names from the mappings.

methods.name: extractAttributeValuesToSearchFilterParam
methods.description: Extracts attribute values from an LDAP entry into a search filter parameter object.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates an instance from an array of employee selector mappings, validating fields.
